title: Tamil Nadu: rent and security deposits
acts: Tamil Nadu Regulation of Rights and Responsibilities of Landlords and Tenants Act, 2017
stateActs: Tamil Nadu Regulation of Rights and Responsibilities of Landlords and Tenants Act, 2017

rules.label: Getting back a security deposit or advance rent

limitation.starts: the date the landlord takes back the vacant premises and fails to refund
limitation.source: Limitation Act, 1963, Schedule, Article 113 (general period for civil claims). The Tamil Nadu Act sets no separate period for deposit claims in the sections checked. Confirm.

forums.name: Rent Court for the urban area
forums.notes: Only the Rent Court, and not a civil court, hears landlord and tenant disputes under the Act (sections 34 and 40). The Rent Authority's powers cover rent revision, deposit of rent, repairs and essential services, not deposit refunds. Appeals go to the Rent Tribunal.

forums.name: Lok Adalat or mediation through the State Legal Services Authority
forums.notes: Free and quick if the other side agrees.

documents: rent agreement, and proof it was registered with the Rent Authority
proof of the date the landlord took back possession
messages or letters asking for the refund
rules.notes: Unless the agreement says otherwise, a deposit above three times the monthly rent is unlawful (section 11(1)). The deposit is due when the landlord takes back the vacant premises (section 11(2), as amended in 2018). An unregistered agreement may not be accepted as evidence (section 4A). The Act covers urban areas and some premises are excluded (section 3).

rules.label: Appeal against an order of the Rent Authority

limitation.starts: the date of the Rent Authority's order
limitation.source: Tamil Nadu Regulation of Rights and Responsibilities of Landlords and Tenants Act, 2017, section 33(2), as substituted in 2018

documents: copy of the Rent Authority's order
rules.notes: The Act does not say whether a late appeal can be accepted. Ask a lawyer.

rules.label: Appeal against a final order of the Rent Court

limitation.starts: the date of the Rent Court's final order
limitation.source: Tamil Nadu Regulation of Rights and Responsibilities of Landlords and Tenants Act, 2017, section 38(1), as substituted in 2018

forums.name: Rent Tribunal for the area where the premises are

documents: copy of the final order of the Rent Court
the application, reply and evidence filed in the Rent Court
rules.notes: The Act makes the Tribunal's decision final (section 38(5)). Ask a lawyer whether any other remedy remains.
